★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Tariq was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Klaus taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Yuki has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Klaus is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
